notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - A New Level And An Outfit!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We just updated the game with a brand new level! The level is called Green Hills and it's available in the mission mode! When you complete this mission, you will get a brand new outfit, named "Mutant"!

We also fixed some major bugs:
-Fixed Archer dying instantly on level 2 in Challenge Mode.
-Fixed Archer unlocking instead of Athlete after completing the game.




THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING THE GAME!

Best Regards,
Gamma Industries
